title: Researchers Claim Two RCE Exploits That Bypass Telegram’s New Android Defenses
summary: A malicious widget can bypass the security filter that Telegram added to its Android app last week and run code outside it, according to NebuSec, a security company.
card_summary: A malicious widget can bypass the security filter that Telegram added to its Android app last week and run code outside it, according to NebuSec, a security company.

sections.impact:
Widgets are small interactive blocks that bots send inside chat messages, and their JavaScript runs on the user's phone.

Assessed severity: MEDIUM.
